detail.longDescription: I've just amended a commit, and now I'd like to push this (using Git BASH), but this fails: ddesca@hostname MINGW64 /c/Development/.../rpi (main) $ git push --force-with-lease ... To http://<machine_name>:8080/tfs/<main_directory>/rpi/_git/rpi ! [remote rejected] main -> main (TF401027: You need the Git 'ForcePush' permission to perform this action. Details: identity '<Domain>\ddesca', scope 'branch'.) error: failed to push some refs to 'http://<machine_name>:8080/tfs/<main_directory>/rpi/_git/rpi' I asked an A.I. bot for some help, and it gave me the advice to surf to that machine, and look for the "project settings": Then, it tells me to go to "main" branch or branch security settings, but I don't see that anywhere. I know I'm part of the "rpi team" and I indeed believe that this is the key to solve this issue, but how can I alter "rpi team" permissions? When I go to the main branch, this is what I see: How can I find the security settings from here?
